steps.name: Environment persistence and runtime validation
steps.description: Validate node/npm versions and create a runtime-evaluated /etc/profile.d/frontend_env.sh (safe, single-quoted here-doc). Do not force NODE_ENV globally; create a project-scoped .env.development with REACT_APP_API_BASE_URL default. Ensure workspace exists. This step ensures tools remain available in future sessions and is idempotent.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98491/WebFrontend"
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "node not found" >&2; exit 2; }
command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "npm not found" >&2; exit 3; }
NODE_MAJOR=$(node -v | sed -E 's/^v([0-9]+).*/\1/')
NPM_MAJOR=$(npm -v | sed -E 's/^([0-9]+).*/\1/')
[ "$NODE_MAJOR" -ge 16 ] || { echo "node >=16 required, found $(node -v)" >&2; exit 4; }
[ "$NPM_MAJOR" -ge 8 ] || { echo "npm >=8 required, found $(npm -v)" >&2; exit 5; }
sudo tee /etc/profile.d/frontend_env.sh > /dev/null <<'EOF'
# Frontend dev environment - evaluated at shell runtime
if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  NPM_GLOB_BIN="$(npm bin -g 2>/dev/null || echo /usr/local/bin)"
  case ":$PATH:" in
    *":$NPM_GLOB_BIN":*) ;;
    *) export PATH="$NPM_GLOB_BIN:$PATH" ;;
  esac
fi
# Do NOT set NODE_ENV globally; project-level defaults live in .env.development
: "No global NODE_ENV set by this script"
EOF
sudo chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/frontend_env.sh
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE"
cat > "$WORKSPACE/.env.development" <<'EOF'
# Project-local defaults for CRA dev
NODE_ENV=development
REACT_APP_API_BASE_URL=${API_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:8000}
EOF
# Source for current session only
set +u
if [ -f "$WORKSPACE/.env.development" ]; then
  export $(grep -v '^#' "$WORKSPACE/.env.development" | xargs) || true
fi
set -u
command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "npm not on PATH after env setup" >&2; exit 6; }

steps.name: Scaffold React app (CRA core template) into workspace
steps.description: Idempotently create a minimal Create React App (JavaScript) in a temporary directory and move artifacts into the workspace. Prefer preinstalled create-react-app from image; fallback to pinned npx create-react-app@5.0.1 only if network available. Validate generated package.json contains react-scripts. Initialize git if missing.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98491/WebFrontend"
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE"
if [ -f "$WORKSPACE/package.json" ] && [ -d "$WORKSPACE/src" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d)
LOG="$WORKSPACE/.scaffold.log"
cd "$TMPDIR"
if command -v create-react-app >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  create-react-app . --use-npm >"$LOG" 2>&1 || { tail -n 200 "$LOG" >&2; rm -rf "$TMPDIR"; exit 7; }
else
  if curl -sSf --head https://www.npmjs.com/ >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    npx --yes create-react-app@5.0.1 . --use-npm >"$LOG" 2>&1 || { tail -n 200 "$LOG" >&2; rm -rf "$TMPDIR"; exit 8; }
  else
    echo "create-react-app not available and network unreachable" >&2; rm -rf "$TMPDIR"; exit 9
  fi
fi
node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); if(!((p.dependencies&&p.dependencies['react-scripts'])||(p.devDependencies&&p.devDependencies['react-scripts']))){console.error('react-scripts missing'); process.exit(1);}"
rsync -a --exclude='.git' --delete ./ "$WORKSPACE/"
rm -rf "$TMPDIR"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
if [ ! -d .git ]; then
  GIT_NAME=${GIT_COMMITTER_NAME:-"autobot"}
  GIT_EMAIL=${GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL:-"autobot@example.com"}
  git init >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  git config user.name "$GIT_NAME" || true
  git config user.email "$GIT_EMAIL" || true
  git add -A >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  git commit -m "scaffold: initial CRA" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi

steps.name: Install dependencies and pin dev tools deterministically
steps.description: Ensure package.json exists, inject minimal devDependencies (serve@14.2.0, eslint, jest, browser-image-resizer optional) if missing, and run a single deterministic install: use npm ci when package-lock.json exists, otherwise npm install. Create dev_uploads and mock_s3 directories and validate that node_modules/.bin/react-scripts, eslint, and jest exist. Fail fast with clear error codes if installation cannot complete.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98491/WebFrontend"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
[ -f package.json ] || { echo "package.json missing; run scaffold first" >&2; exit 10; }
# Inject minimal devDependencies deterministically if absent and emit marker
CHANGED=$(node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json'));p.devDependencies=p.devDependencies||{};let ch=false;const ensure=(k,v)=>{if(!p.devDependencies[k]){p.devDependencies[k]=v;ch=true}};ensure('serve','14.2.0');ensure('eslint','8.0.0');ensure('jest','29.0.0');ensure('browser-image-resizer','0.12.0');if(ch){fs.writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2));console.log('UPDATED')}" ) || true
# Deterministic install: prefer lockfile
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
  npm ci --no-audit --prefer-offline --silent
else
  npm install --no-audit --prefer-offline --silent
fi
# If we injected devDeps, run a single install to bring them in
if [ "${CHANGED}" = "UPDATED" ]; then
  npm install --no-audit --prefer-offline --silent
fi
# Ensure minimal scripts
node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json'));p.scripts=p.scripts||{};p.scripts.start=p.scripts.start||'react-scripts start';p.scripts.build=p.scripts.build||'react-scripts build';p.scripts.test=p.scripts.test||'jest --colors';p.scripts['serve:static']=p.scripts['serve:static']||'serve -s build -l \"$PORT\"';fs.writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2));" >/dev/null
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/dev_uploads" "$WORKSPACE/mock_s3"
# Validate required binaries
if [ ! -x "$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/react-scripts" ]; then
  echo "react-scripts binary missing; re-run npm ci or check package-lock.json" >&2; exit 11
fi
if [ ! -x "$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/eslint" ] || [ ! -x "$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/jest" ]; then
  echo "eslint or jest not installed locally; ensure network is available and re-run this install step" >&2; exit 12
fi
echo "dependencies installed and dev tools present"

steps.name: Testing setup and smoke test (ESLint + Jest)
steps.description: Add a minimal ESLint config and a single Jest smoke test, then run lint and tests using local binaries. If local eslint/jest are missing, attempt a single non-interactive npm install to populate them (only if network reachable). Fail with clear instructions if still missing.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98491/WebFrontend"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# Minimal ESLint config
if [ ! -f .eslintrc.json ]; then
  cat >.eslintrc.json <<'EOF'
{ "env": { "browser": true, "es2021": true }, "extends": "eslint:recommended", "parserOptions": { "ecmaVersion": 12, "sourceType": "module" }, "rules": {} }
EOF
fi
# Ensure smoke test
mkdir -p src/__tests__
cat > src/__tests__/smoke.test.js <<'EOF'
test('smoke: true is true', ()=>{ expect(true).toBe(true); });
EOF
ESLINT_BIN="./node_modules/.bin/eslint"
JEST_BIN="./node_modules/.bin/jest"
# If local bins missing, attempt one safe install if network reachable
if [ ! -x "$ESLINT_BIN" ] || [ ! -x "$JEST_BIN" ]; then
  if curl -sSf --head https://registry.npmjs.org/ >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    npm install --no-audit --prefer-offline --silent
  else
    echo "local eslint/jest missing and network unavailable. Run deps-01 (install) step or provide offline node_modules tarball." >&2
    exit 14
  fi
fi
# Run lint and tests
if [ -x "$ESLINT_BIN" ]; then
  "$ESLINT_BIN" src --max-warnings=0 || { echo 'eslint failed' >&2; exit 13; }
else
  echo 'local eslint missing after install attempt' >&2; exit 14
fi
if [ -x "$JEST_BIN" ]; then
  "$JEST_BIN" --colors --runInBand --ci || { echo 'jest failed' >&2; exit 15; }
else
  echo 'local jest missing after install attempt' >&2; exit 16
fi

steps.name: Build, serve built bundle, health-check and clean stop
steps.description: Build the app with react-scripts build, serve the build using local serve binary (install locally if absent), pick an ephemeral port, wait for HTTP 2xx/3xx response, verify HTML content, and cleanup server and temp files. Provides evidence: build size and serve log tail.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98491/WebFrontend"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
npm run build --silent
[ -d build ] || { echo "build directory missing" >&2; exit 20; }
PORT=$(python3 - <<'PY'
import socket
s=socket.socket()
s.bind(('127.0.0.1',0))
port=s.getsockname()[1]
s.close()
print(port)
PY
)
if [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/serve ]; then
  SERVE_BIN=./node_modules/.bin/serve
else
  npm install --no-audit --prefer-offline --silent serve@14.2.0
  SERVE_BIN=./node_modules/.bin/serve
fi
LOG=$(mktemp -p "$WORKSPACE" .serve_log.XXXX)
RESP=$(mktemp -p "$WORKSPACE" .resp.XXXX)
HEADER=$(mktemp -p "$WORKSPACE" .hdr.XXXX)
SERVER_PID=0
cleanup(){ if [ "$SERVER_PID" -ne 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then kill "$SERVER_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; rm -f "$LOG" "$RESP" "$HEADER" 2>/dev/null || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
( "$SERVE_BIN" -s build -l "$PORT" >"$LOG" 2>&1 ) &
SERVER_PID=$!
RETRIES=0
MAX_RETRIES=7
while true; do
  STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/" 2>/dev/null || echo 000)
  if [ "$STATUS" != "000" ] && [ "$STATUS" -ge 200 ] && [ "$STATUS" -lt 400 ]; then break; fi
  if [ "$RETRIES" -ge "$MAX_RETRIES" ]; then echo "server failed to return 2xx/3xx; see $LOG" >&2; tail -n 200 "$LOG" >&2; exit 21; fi
  SLEEP_SEC=$(( RETRIES<5 ? (1<<RETRIES) : 32 ))
  sleep "$SLEEP_SEC"
  RETRIES=$((RETRIES+1))
done
curl -sS -D "$HEADER" -o "$RESP" "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/"
CT=$(tr -d '\r' <"$HEADER" | grep -i '^Content-Type:' || true)
if ! echo "$CT" | grep -qi 'html' && ! grep -qi '<html' "$RESP" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "validation: served content not HTML" >&2; cat "$RESP" >&2; exit 22; fi
echo "build_size_bytes: $(du -sb build | cut -f1)"
echo "serve_log_tail:" && tail -n 50 "$LOG" || true
